contracts.normative_equation_or_contract:
`SC-ARG2B-CL-C-DOMAIN` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the declared quartic source/target joint completion, unique Lipschitz section and certified physical evaluation. No section derivative, whole-chart invariance or arbitrary-graph theorem is admitted.

The quartic A-family coefficients remain eta=1/1024, kappa_c=kappa_Ah=1/64,
chi=zeta=kappa_H=1/2, alpha=beta=gamma=1/32768, W_floor=1/2 and tau_A=32.
The site derivative is (C−2)^3−(C−2). Only the ordinary duration changes from
the earlier A-family constructions. C and W_A are the entire physical state;
H is derived from a unique completion-relative invariant section.

The fixed-H read is the existing A law. Its potential includes both the
weighted graph Laplacian and B(H−I)B^T C/64. Its selected current consumes
the conductance drive and the physical closure denominator. Its causal flat
uses H inverse; G is the symmetric star-supported outer-product geometry.
The conductance writer consumes updated C, incoming W, and that selected
current. Both H consumers and the entire writer enter every proof below.

For each graph, X=(C,64 log W) is the auxiliary coordinate system. The
declaration fixes separate rational resource intervals for every vertex
and |64 log W|≤1/16. Let P_arg clip **arguments** to this box. The completion is

    Fhat(X,H) = X + f(P_arg X,H),   Ghat(X,H) = G(P_arg X,H).

This is a bounded-increment extension to all auxiliary X. Physical resources
and conductances are never clipped. Every source query, propagated tube and
entire trapping domain is separately checked strictly inside the agreement
chart. No forward-invariance claim is made for the whole rectangular chart.
The older native zero-site bounds and native K_minus admission are not reused.

Exact rational global bounds use the full norm max(||C||inf,64||log W||inf),
the induced infinity norm on symmetric star-supported H, geometry radius
1/1024 and section Lipschitz class 1/256. Vertex-specific cubic derivatives
retain exact graph cancellation before bounding the W and H perturbations.
The resource and writer partials jointly give A_X+A_H L<1 on both graphs.
Consequently every section-dependent completed base map has a global inverse.
The graph transform maps its closed bounded Lipschitz class strictly into
itself and contracts. Its fixed point is Gamma(C,W), not Gamma at frozen W.
The image Lipschitz bound also sharpens the Lipschitz constant of that fixed
point. The records contain all rational operands and inequalities.

Uniform duration 32 is **uncertified** for this construction. Preliminary
duration-8/16/24/32 probes guide the choice; they are not proofs. Duration 16
passes the fresh joint inverse bounds. Failure of the available duration-32
bound is not a universal impossibility result. Changing duration changes the
discrete map, its writer and its invariant section; beat counts and elapsed
time are both reported.

`SC-ARG2B-CL-C-FULL-TRAP` is accepted for the direct continuous domain on the exact charge-21 state space, covering all fourteen resource and sixteen conductance directions, with a common pairwise contraction and strict self-map.

Write A=BB^T and P=(A+11^T/n)^−1. On the exact charge-21 tangent, use

    ||(delta C,delta Y)|| = max(sqrt(delta C^T P delta C), ||delta Y||2),
    Y = 64 log W.

One rational degree-40 polynomial p(s), 0≤s≤1, defines the common domain

    K = {p(s)+v : 0≤s≤1, sum(v_C)=0, ||v||≤1/4096}.

Every point has a full thirty-dimensional neighborhood relative to charge:
fourteen resource and sixteen conductance directions. The floating proposal
uses a stationary reference and the reset prefix endpoint at 300. It requires
no later state. The final certificate treats every coefficient as exact
rational data and takes **no executed trajectory as input**.

Exact Bernstein ranges cover the entire parameter interval. A scalar FLINT
series implementation independently evaluates the complete fixed-I current
and writer. A fourth-order Taylor enclosure bounds the functional residual
F_I(p(s))−p((999/1000)s) on an exact gap-free partition of 67 cells. This
replaces a much slower first-order residual bound; no sampled parameter values
stand in for a continuous proof.

Exact charge-tangent LDL inequalities bound the self-adjoint resource
reference. The full C/W block difference bound includes the normalized rows,
both H consumers, writer feedback and the Lipschitz section difference.
The result is q<0.998534, functional defect <8.858e−8 and strict image
margin >2.6939e−7. Uniform weighted row, anchor, edge and complete-basin
checks hold on all of K; the minimum edge margin exceeds 8.3817e−5.
Both chiral rosters are

    p: [p, private]
    sc2-positive-module/satellite/2:
      [n2, n8, sc2-positive-module/satellite/2].

The physical current tube enters at parameter 9997/10000 and reset at 1.
Their next two membership checks use that parameter times (999/1000)^k.
Different parameter choices reflect their distinct conductance histories.
The strict domain image bound supplies closure; there is no finite union
whose last component depends on a subsequent supporting trajectory.

`SC-ARG2B-CL-C-COMPLETION` is accepted for the declared actual source/event/resource-and-history transfer, physical approach and positive window. Current earns one local child; reset and read-only replay earn zero live gain.

Finite section queries use sixteen coupled inverse levels, including the
writer, with terminal H=I. Newton and geometry sweeps propose dyadic operands
at 384 bits. FLINT/Arb verifies all state and geometry residuals at 768 bits;
the graph-transform tail and residual amplification enclose the true section.
No derivative of Gamma or unproved C1 regularity is assumed.

The source has twelve vertices and thirteen edges. A fresh exact charge-21
prestate is frozen before the campaign; its ordinary beat, full parent basin,
saturation and event trigger are checked. Current source conductances start
at 4097/4096; reset starts at 8191/8192 and is not advanced. The expansion
copies exterior resources, sets the new core to zero and allocates the old
core with shares 5/2048, 1021/1024, 1/2048. Old-edge W is preserved and the
three new internal edges start at one. Both complete source histories are
archived. The target section is rebuilt from its own graph and full C/W state;
no H history is transported.

Each exact-charge dyadic center has a propagated full-state error tube.
Every source, allocation, finite-section and rounding error enters its radius.
The invariant identity

    Gamma(F(X,Gamma(X))) = G(X,Gamma(X))

allows the next section enclosure to be reused, with the **full C/log-W**
center displacement included. It does not introduce H as physical state.
Fresh inverse-chain rebuilds at beats 1, 300 and 302 check consistency with
reuse; overlap is not substituted for the invariance proof. Checkpoint
physical reads enclose the whole tube. Both chiral graphs have identical
incidence, edge order and fixed-row equations, which is checked explicitly.

Both fresh physical prefixes enter at beat 300 and finish the positive two-beat
window at 302. Ordinary duration is uniformly 16, including the source beat;
window elapsed time is 32 and elapsed target time is 4832. Last execution is
302 and zero later supporting steps are required. These are sufficient witness
times, not earliest-completion or duration-32 feasibility claims. Membership is
checked at parameters (9997/10000)(999/1000)^k for current and (999/1000)^k for
reset, k=0,1,2. Both chiral charts have uniform complete basins throughout K.

Every physical center and propagated tube is checked against the agreement
chart and direct domain at the selected endpoints. The exact domain checker
accepts no executed trajectory input. Joint C/log-W centers use 320-bit dyadic
coordinates and 256-bit tube radii; FLINT/Arb certification uses 768 bits.
All source, event, allocation, section, history and roundoff errors are included.

Six scientific tests and seven surface/provenance tests passed. Both complete
302-step physical prefixes were freshly replayed with the same implementation;
no independent external review is asserted. Two eight-step preflights checked
immutable graph/domain caches, multi-RHS partials, proposal early stops and
certified section reuse. Fourth-order interval Taylor residual bounds certified
67 exact Bernstein cells with 70 evaluations. One-hour campaign and certificate
caps remain in force; each selected physical prefix took about one minute.

All 604 selected states remain XZ compressed, from 40,812,993 to 5,289,508 bytes.
Compact earlier discovery/history and exact generator snapshots remain; redundant
full trajectories are absent. Acceptance reruns no numerical campaign and
preserves original execution flags and research projection.
